newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Degussa started at JP Morgan.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Degussa started at JP Morgan.

text.p: German chemicals, metals and drugs group Degussa was rated "buy" as JP Morgan started coverage of the stock, the investment bank said on Tuesday.

In a research note, JP Morgan analyst Peter Houghton said the stock was not the widely spread business it was often seen as, adding that its management "has the potential to unlock value and appears willing to do so."
He said the company should deliver 15 percent annual earnings per share growth through 2000 and that after a 22 percent underperformance against the German chemical sector it was undervalued.
